audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Singed four of seven stages in a matchup Singed loses, and it contradicts its own prose. spikes[0] is titled 'Lvl 1-3' and ends 'he owns this phase cleanly', whys[0], whys[1] and whys[2] all describe Teemo winning, yet the chart scores Level 1 'Skill' and Levels 2-3 'Singed'. The two-item stage is scored Singed while whys[6] says he wins the late shroom war through map denial.
audit.why: Emerald+ 49.00% over 1245 games — this is the only losing matchup in the slice apart from Urgot, and a chart that hands Singed the majority of stages flatly contradicts the headline number the page prints above it. The packet chart reads Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Skill, Singed, Skill, which matches both the win rate and every sentence of the prose.
audit.corrected: Chart moved as one group to the packet read across both layers, with phases[0], [1], [2] and [6] why rewritten.

audit.why: Levels 1-3, level 6, Rylai's and the late shroom grid are the right four spikes, and whys[1] already carries the correct flat 7-second Blinding Dart cooldown. Insanity Potion is a flat 100s, and Noxious Trap has effectively no cooldown at 0.25s per throw from a stored pack — which is why the late-game shroom grid is a spike rather than a window.

audit.whatIsWrong: One false claim and one large omission. The late paragraph says 'his E poison ignores your magic resistance stacking'. And Move Quick is treated as an unconditional escape — whys[2] blames 'enough passive move speed to dodge a standalone throw' — with no mention of the condition attached to it.
audit.why: Toxic Shot is an on-hit poison dealing magic damage; magic resist reduces it like any other magic damage, so telling a Singed player his MR does nothing against Teemo is simply wrong and will change what he builds. The omission is bigger: Riot's Move Quick text is 'passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck.' Poison Trail striking him removes the passive half — so the very speed the page says lets him walk out of the goo is something your Q turns off. Tag first, throw second. The page also gets the blind exactly right (it stops autos and on-hits, never the poison aura), which is worth keeping.
audit.corrected: late, whys[2], whys[4], report[5].t, dosFull[1].t, dontsFull[0].d, wants.you[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Once Rylai's is complete the lane dynamic inverts — your Poison Trail is now a permanent slow field and anyone standing in it is glued there while your damage accumulates. Teemo's shrooms shift from lane tools to map-control weapons, so respect every brush and objective approach; never facecheck anything near baron or dragon. In the side lane you win the straight 1v1 at this point because he cannot escape your cloud, but the real threat is his shroom grid making your team's map movement costly. Push your wave and roam rather than sitting in a shroom-blanketed lane, and if the game goes very late and he has full items remember that his E poison ignores your magic resistance stacking — keep Rylai's active and never let him kite you into a shroom chain.
edits.after: Once Rylai's is complete the lane dynamic inverts — your Poison Trail is a permanent slow field and anyone standing in it is glued there while your damage accumulates. In the side lane you win the straight 1v1 because he cannot escape your cloud, but the real threat is his shroom grid taxing your team's every rotation. Push your wave and roam rather than sitting in a shroomed side lane, and remember Toxic Shot is magic damage, so the magic resist you bought does cut it — keep Rylai's active and never let him kite you into a shroom chain.

notes: The _missing rule for this pair claims mutual displacement, 'Fling (E) vs Noxious Trap (R)'. Noxious Trap slows and damages; it does not knock up, and the knockup flag on it is a tooltip-parsing misfire, so I did not write that line. Mirror consequence: audits/top/teemo__singed.json was written earlier and left the level chart on the generic template, so the Teemo page still shows Skill at level 1 and Singed at levels 2-3. My side now gives Teemo all three, which is what a 49.00% Singed win rate and both pages' prose require. The two directions disagree until mirror-fix.js runs, and it should take this read. Not written for lack of a field: Guerrilla Warfare lets Teemo hold invisibility while moving in brush, and Poison Trail damage is what breaks it — worth a line if a field frees up.
